rows.description: pipelineProposal calls parsePipeline(record.yaml) unguarded, and discard calls it before removing anything. A stored record whose YAML no longer parses (hand-edited, or a format change after an upgrade) makes show, apply and discard throw, and discard is the only way to clear it from the CLI. discard should not need the parse, and show should report the problem as a refusal.

'What the person reads is what is written' is enforced only on the way in (hiddenCharacterProblem in proposePipeline). The accept path never rechecks it: show and apply print through plain(), which turns hidden or bidi characters into spaces, but acceptPipelineProposal writes record.yaml unchanged. A record put into .kodel/proposals/ by another route can carry U+202E or a control character that the person sees as a space and that is written and run. Refuse in pipelineProposal (set refused) when hiddenCharacterProblem(record.yaml) is set; also validate kind and base_hash on read, since readPipelineProposal checks only v and name.

The hidden-character list misses zero-width and invisible characters (U+200B to U+200D, U+2060, U+FEFF, U+00AD, U+180E), invisible in the text and in the commands block, and plain() lets them through.

The stem check is case-sensitive. On a case-insensitive filesystem a file Foo.yaml that declares another name, or is invalid, does not make a new pipeline foo count as taken, and replaceFile then overwrites Foo.yaml. Compare stems case-insensitively.

acceptPipelineProposal re-checks base_hash and name-taken inside pipelineProposal, then writes later with replaceFile (a rename that overwrites): a file created or edited in between is silently overwritten. The window is small but the plan promises refusal when the file moved.
The plan names checkProposedName and says PipelineProposalInfo.warnings exists but stays empty; the code has proposalNameProblem and leaves warnings unset. Plan and code disagree.

Test gaps against the plan: no core test (fake host) for a name in use being a change, a name that is not a file name, or invalid YAML refused with the parser message; no test of the [new] mark for check commands through show; no test that a corrupt or unparsable stored record cannot escape a tool call or the CLI.
The prose matches the engine on the points checked; the engine also refuses a no-op change and more than 10 waiting proposals, which the docs do not say.
A throw from the host's proposePipeline (a store I/O error) is not turned into {ok:false}: guarded converts only KodelError. Matches the existing flow; the local host returns refusals as values.
The hash covers only the YAML, so the summary can change between show and apply; the confirmation prints the summary again at confirm time, so this is cosmetic.
